hook: HYDRAA's chief keeps his seat. Court protection runs to *January*
hook_b: HYDRAA's chief keeps his seat. Court protection runs to *January*
tldr: Telangana HC extended interim protection for HYDRAA Commissioner Ranganath until January.

beats.what: The High Court extended interim protection to Ranganath until January, keeping a single-judge order to replace him on hold.
beats.why: The single bench found HYDRAA's actions amounted to wilful disobedience of court directions (July 27). The division bench stayed the order on Sept 1 and questioned whether HYDRAA demolished hastily.
beats.care: HYDRAA's demolition and lake-protection drives continue under the same leadership for now.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Background from The News Minute: the dispute involves a 40-acre property at Lothkunta, Malkajgiri; HYDRAA says the land is government property.

cards.q: Before any demolition, what should HYDRAA do first?

steps.e: Single judge finds wilful disobedience; orders his replacement
Division bench stays that order; hearing set for Nov 3

watch: The January hearing date and any ruling on the contempt appeals.
